title: Everyday Phrases — Berry Picking at a Farm
scene_zh: 果園採摘 · 情境對話
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🍓 實用果園採摘必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Berry Picking at a Farm
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「果園採摘」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。場景是週末的採果農場：領籃子走進果園、挑熟透的莓果先嚐一顆、邊摘邊聊天氣與蟲子、小心別踩到秧苗，最後排隊稱重結帳、再順手帶一罐果醬回家。400 句循環聽，A2 程度，零基礎也能跟著開口說。常用句型包含問能不能採、說甜不甜、請人遞籃子、稱重與付錢。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'Berry Picking at a Farm' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). The scene is a pick-your-own berry farm on a weekend: grabbing a basket, walking into the rows, tasting one berry to see if it is ripe, chatting about the weather and bugs while picking, watching out for the young plants, then weighing the basket at the counter and taking a jar of jam home. 400 lines on repeat, A2 level, easy to repeat out loud even from zero.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this the berry farm?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the sign says so.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should we park the car?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a lot near the gate.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we pay before we pick?
dialogue.zh: 我們採之前要先付錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You pay when you leave.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's grab two baskets over there.
dialogue.zh: 我們去那邊拿兩個籃子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: These plastic ones look strong.
dialogue.zh: 這些塑膠的看起來很耐用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much do the baskets cost?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The baskets come with the ticket.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sun hats are sold at the counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌn hæts ər soʊld æt ðə ˈkaʊntər/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm fine with just sunscreen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The gate opens at eight sharp.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we're right on time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which way leads to the berries?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Follow the dirt path downhill.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the rows far from here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's about five minutes away.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we bring water with us?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a fountain by the shed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This field smells like fresh grass.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bees love the clover here.
dialogue.zh: 蜜蜂很愛這裡的三葉草。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone is waving us over.
dialogue.zh: 有人在招手叫我們過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the farm guide, I think.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning, are you the guide?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's me, welcome to the farm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell us how picking works here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twist the berry gently, then pull.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I twist it like this?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, use your fingertips only.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which rows have the most fruit?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the second row today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are those rows already picked clean?
dialogue.zh: 那幾排已經被採光了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly, but some branches hide more.
dialogue.zh: 大致上是，但有些枝條還藏著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's start at the far end.
dialogue.zh: 我們從最遠那頭開始吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, fewer people walk there.
dialogue.zh: 聰明，那裡走的人比較少。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How big should our basket be?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A medium one holds enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This handle feels a bit loose.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Swap it for a sturdier one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we leave our bags here?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以把包包放在這裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave them behind the counter.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The ground is soft from rain.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wear boots if you have them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mud is stuck on my shoes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Scrape them on the wooden board.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's walk slowly between the rows.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watch out for the little plants.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These leaves are wet and cool.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Morning dew always feels nice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which row should we try first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start where the sign points left.
dialogue.zh: 從牌子指左邊那裡開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tall bushes block the whole view.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Duck under this low branch.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that row reserved for groups?
dialogue.zh: 那排是保留給團體的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only on busy weekend mornings.
dialogue.zh: 只有在繁忙的週末早上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our basket is still empty though.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it ten minutes, honestly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nobody told us about the rules.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just don't step on the roots.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rows are labeled with little flags.
dialogue.zh: 行列上插著小旗子標示。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue flags mean sweet and ripe.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's begin with the blue flags.
dialogue.zh: 我們從藍旗那幾排開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good plan, they're closest anyway.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rows of bushes stretch forever.
dialogue.zh: 一排排的樹叢延伸無盡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stay near me, don't wander off.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smell that sweet air right here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's like jam already, almost.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Grandpa used to pick at farms.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He told you the best tricks?
dialogue.zh: 他跟你說過最好的訣竅嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Small berries taste sweeter than big ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl ˈbɛriz teɪst ˈswitər ðæn bɪɡ wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 小顆的莓果比大顆的甜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Really, I always pick the biggest.
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎，我總是挑最大的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Birds eat the top ones first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we should reach lower down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My fingers are turning purple.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means you're doing it right.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do berries stain our clothes badly?
dialogue.zh: 莓果會把衣服染得很糟嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wash them with cold water soon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This basket fills faster than expected.
dialogue.zh: 這個籃子比預期裝得快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll need another one soon.
dialogue.zh: 我們很快會需要另一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone left a hat on the fence.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmwʌn lɛft ə hæt ɑn ðə fɛns/
dialogue.zh: 有人把帽子留在圍籬上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe the owner will come back.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we allowed to eat while picking?
dialogue.phonetic: /ər wi əˈlaʊd tə it waɪl ˈpɪkɪŋ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One or two is fine, not more.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ɔr tu ɪz faɪn nɑt mɔr/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I'll taste just this one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold it up to the light first.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɪt ʌp tə ðə laɪt fɜrst/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This whole row looks promising.
dialogue.zh: 整排看起來都很有希望。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us keep looking anyway.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which bucket belongs to us now?
dialogue.zh: 現在哪個桶子是我們的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The red handle marks ours.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's split up for ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Meet me by the tall post.
dialogue.zh: 在高柱子那邊跟我碰面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Careful, the fence has sharp wire.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, I'll keep my distance.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunlight is getting warmer now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's finish before noon hits.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two hours feels like enough time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plenty, if we keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This farm is bigger than I thought.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs fɑrm ɪz ˈbɪɡər ðæn aɪ θɔt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They grow six kinds of berries.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These berries look dark and shiny.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dark ones usually taste the best.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I try one before we start?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ traɪ wʌn bɪˈfɔr wi stɑrt?/
dialogue.zh: 開始前我可以先試一顆嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go ahead, that's the farm rule.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, this one is really sweet.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Told you the dark ones win.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which row tastes the sweetest here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The one beside the water tank.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That one is crowded with people.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait a while, they'll move.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ugh, this berry tastes too sour.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Spit it out behind the bush.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This one feels soft and mushy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave those for the birds.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands are sticky already.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe them on the grass.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Watch your feet near the seedlings.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, I nearly crushed one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Those thin plants are next year's crop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðoʊz θɪn plænts ər nɛkst jɪrz krɑp/
dialogue.zh: 那些細苗是明年的收成。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we really must be careful.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bees are buzzing around my head.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stay still and they'll pass.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One just landed on my sleeve.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't swat it, walk away slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That scared me more than expected.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit down and breathe a moment.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe we should move somewhere quieter.
dialogue.zh: 也許我們該換到安靜點的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The far rows have fewer bees.
dialogue.zh: 遠一點的行列蜜蜂較少。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Somebody already stripped that row.
dialogue.zh: 有人已經把那排採光了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, only leaves are left there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our whole plan just fell apart.
dialogue.zh: 我們的計畫整個泡湯了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Relax, we still have six rows.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Careful, the basket is tipping over.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, everything spilled out.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Berries are rolling down the hill.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grab the ones near the path.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half of our morning is gone.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's pick again, but smarter.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dirty berries can't be sold anyway.
dialogue.zh: 髒掉的莓果反正也賣不了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll rinse the good ones later.
dialogue.zh: 好的那些我們晚點沖洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time I'll hold it tighter.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set it on flat ground instead.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That lesson cost us ten minutes.
dialogue.zh: 那堂課花了我們十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At least nobody got hurt.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's work in pairs from now on.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts wɜrk ɪn pɛrz frəm naʊ ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 我們從現在開始兩人一組。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, one holds, one picks.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That row near the shed is open.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt roʊ nɪr ðə ʃɛd ɪz ˈoʊpən/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, let's head over there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now we're back on track again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And this time the basket stays.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This spot is quieter and shadier.
dialogue.zh: 這裡比較安靜也比較陰涼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plenty of berries hang here too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Reach for the ones underneath leaves.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Found three hiding right there.
dialogue.zh: 就在那裡找到三顆藏的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Those look even better than before.
dialogue.zh: 那些看起來比之前的更好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Losing that row helped us somehow.
dialogue.zh: 丟了那排反而幫了我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Funny how things work out.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's not plan so tightly again.
dialogue.zh: 我們別再計畫得那麼緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Try this one, it's perfect.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sweet with a tiny bit of tart.
dialogue.phonetic: /swit wɪð ə ˈtaɪni bɪt əv tɑrt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which of these should we keep?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep the firm ones, drop the rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðə fɜrm wʌnz drɑp ðə rɛst/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorting takes longer than picking.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just do it while we walk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Careful with the ones we dropped.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I washed them with my bottle.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honestly, this is more fun now.
dialogue.zh: 老實說，現在這樣更好玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small disasters make good stories.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look at that old wooden ladder.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Workers use it for the high branches.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɜrkərz juz ɪt fɔr ðə haɪ ˈbræntʃɪz/
dialogue.zh: 工人用它搆高處的枝條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we ask to borrow it?
dialogue.zh: 我們要問看看能不能借嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better not, it looks unsafe.
dialogue.zh: 還是不要，看起來不安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair enough, we'll stay on the ground.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr ɪˈnʌf wɪl steɪ ɑn ðə ɡraʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 也對，我們待在地面就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Low branches have plenty anyway.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This basket is half full now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Another hour and we're done.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My back is starting to ache.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand up and stretch your arms.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Those kids over there are laughing.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One just fell into the bushes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kids always find the funniest spots.
dialogue.zh: 小孩總能找到最好玩的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Remember when you were that small?
dialogue.zh: 還記得你那麼小的時候嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Barely, but I remember the taste.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some things never really leave us.
dialogue.zh: 有些事永遠不會真的離開我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's fill this basket properly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No rush, we have all morning.
dialogue.zh: 不急，我們有一整個早上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Actually, it's almost eleven already.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we should speed up a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi ʃʊd spid ʌp ə bɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Steady beats fast when picking berries.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You sound like grandpa right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's the nicest thing you've said.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not get used to it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almost done with this whole row.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, my knees need a rest.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rest under that big oak tree.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sounds perfect after all this bending.
dialogue.zh: 彎腰這麼久之後聽起來很完美。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bring the basket along with us.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I've got it, you go ahead.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This shade feels like a reward.
dialogue.zh: 這片陰涼像是一種獎賞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the berries survived the morning.
dialogue.zh: 而且莓果撐過了這個早上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Weather turned out nicer than forecast.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No clouds at all this morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunblock is dripping into my eyes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, take this clean cloth.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bugs keep landing on my neck.
dialogue.zh: 蟲子一直停在我脖子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They like the sweet juice smell.
dialogue.zh: 牠們喜歡甜果汁的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any plans for the weekend?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing big, maybe a movie.
dialogue.zh: 沒什麼大事，也許看場電影。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wasn't your cousin visiting soon?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saturday, and she loves berries.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then bring her here next time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She'd fill ten baskets alone.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Over there, that family is loud.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They're arguing about the bucket.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Parents always fight over small things.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then they share the pie later.
dialogue.zh: 然後他們晚點又一起分吃那個派。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Their little girl waves at us.
dialogue.zh: 他們的小女兒向我們揮手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wave back, she looks so happy.
dialogue.zh: 揮回去，她看起來好開心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Want to swap baskets for a while?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑnt tə swɑp ˈbæskɪts fɔr ə waɪl?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, mine is getting heavy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yours has a broken side handle.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That explains the strange wobble.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold this one close to your chest.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ðɪs wʌn kloʊs tə jʊr tʃɛst/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Much easier on my arms.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's take a photo together.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand by the fullest bush.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smile, the sun is behind us.
dialogue.zh: 笑一個，太陽在我們後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, my hair is a mess.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nobody cares about your hair.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, take it really quick.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That photo caught your silly face.
dialogue.zh: 那張照片拍到你的傻臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Delete it, I'm serious.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine, but I'm keeping this one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You always keep the worst ones.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clouds are rolling in from the west.
dialogue.phonetic: /klaʊdz ər ˈroʊlɪŋ ɪn frəm ðə wɛst/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe rain by the late afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then we should leave before that.
dialogue.zh: 那我們該在那之前離開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, one more row only.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wind feels lovely on hot skin.
dialogue.zh: 風吹在熱熱的皮膚上很舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nature's own little air conditioner.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Listen, someone is playing music.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's coming from the picnic area.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We should eat there afterwards.
dialogue.zh: 我們之後應該去那裡吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if my back recovers.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two more baskets and we're finished.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's a lot of berries honestly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Neighbors will love a few jars.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And grandma makes great pie.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now my mouth is watering already.
dialogue.zh: 我現在已經在流口水了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Focus, we still have work.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That woman said the jam sells out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈwʊmən sɛd ðə dʒæm sɛlz aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 那位女士說果醬會賣完。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we should buy ours early.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Their kids are counting their berries.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cute, I would eat mine first.
dialogue.zh: 真可愛，我會先吃掉我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One boy dropped his whole box.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Poor kid, he looks heartbroken.
dialogue.zh: 可憐的孩子，他看起來心碎了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we give him some of ours?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi ɡɪv hɪm sʌm əv ˈaʊərz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, we have more than enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His mother just thanked us twice.
dialogue.zh: 他媽媽跟我們道謝了兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kindness travels fast around here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Feels good to share something small.
dialogue.zh: 分享一點小東西感覺很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's what makes a good day.
dialogue.zh: 這就是美好一天的原因。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's finish this last stretch now.
dialogue.zh: 我們把最後這段採完吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My basket is nearly overflowing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stack them gently in the cart.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, that pile looks shaky.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing is falling this time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't say that out loud.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everyone is heading to the shed.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That must be the weighing station.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a line already?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Short one, maybe four people.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, we can rest our legs.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine are completely numb now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dust is all over our shoes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Brush them off before the car.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shirt has purple fingerprints.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it, it tells a story.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nobody will believe this stain.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show them the photo as proof.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almost our turn at the scale.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hand me both baskets please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One basket is heavier than the other.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈbæskɪt ɪz ˈhɛviər ðæn ði ˈʌðər/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one has the big berries.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We should weigh them separately.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Doesn't matter, the price is the same.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdʌzənt ˈmætər ðə praɪs ɪz ðə seɪm/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the price per pound?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three dollars, cash or card.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We have about six pounds here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's eighteen dollars altogether.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sounds fair for a morning's work.
dialogue.zh: 以一個早上的成果來說很合理。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cheaper than the grocery store.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And these taste much fresher.
dialogue.zh: 而且這些嚐起來新鮮多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Freshness is worth the dirt.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's pay and get the jam.
dialogue.zh: 我們付錢然後去買果醬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Jam would make a lovely gift.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She'll be thrilled with that gift.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add a small bag of berries too.
dialogue.phonetic: /æd ə smɔl bæɡ əv ˈbɛriz tu/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Checkout line is moving quickly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect timing before the rain.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please put the baskets on the scale.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz pʊt ðə ˈbæskɪts ɑn ðə skeɪl/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One at a time, gently.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The needle stops at seven pounds.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: More than we guessed earlier.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that include the basket weight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we subtract the empty ones.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，我們會扣掉空籃重。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then it's really about six pounds.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, eighteen dollars in total.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's a twenty dollar bill.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two dollars back, here you go.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we buy a jar of jam?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi baɪ ə dʒɑr əv dʒæm?/
dialogue.zh: 我們也可以買一罐果醬嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, strawberry or mixed berry?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mixed berry sounds more interesting.
dialogue.zh: 綜合莓聽起來有意思些。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's made from this very farm.
dialogue.zh: 就是用這個農場的果子做的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does the jam last?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six months if kept cool.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's plenty of time for us.
dialogue.zh: 對我們來說時間很充裕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone says it disappears faster.
dialogue.zh: 大家都說它消失得更快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two jars might be safer.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, the shelf is almost empty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please bag the jam separately.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anything else before I ring it up?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌθɪŋ ɛls bɪˈfɔr aɪ rɪŋ ɪt ʌp?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's everything, thanks very much.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The two jars come to four dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tu dʒɑrz kʌm tu fɔr ˈdɑlərz/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you take a credit card?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tap it right here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The machine beeps and approves it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here's your receipt and a bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could we wash our hands somewhere?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以去哪裡洗手嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sink is around that corner.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold water feels amazing right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wash your face too, you're red.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's sit on the bench outside.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just ten minutes, then we drive.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These clouds still look harmless.
dialogue.zh: 這些雲看起來還是無害。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wind changed, rain is unlikely.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then we can drive home slowly.
dialogue.zh: 那我們可以慢慢開回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No hurry on a Sunday afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put the jam carefully in the trunk.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ðə dʒæm ˈkɛrfəli ɪn ðə trʌŋk/
dialogue.zh: 把果醬小心放進後車廂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wrap it in this old towel.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Buckets in the back seat, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They'll smell wonderful the whole way.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we come back next month?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blackberries ripen by then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mark the calendar right now.
dialogue.zh: 現在就在日曆上記下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Already saved it in my phone.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same time, same parking spot.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And this time two sturdy baskets.
dialogue.zh: 這次帶兩個牢固的籃子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Today turned out better than planned.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even the spilled basket helped.
dialogue.zh: 連打翻的籃子都有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Engine starts on the first try.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good sign for the drive home.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dusty fields slide past the window.
dialogue.zh: 滿是灰塵的田野從窗外滑過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Roll it down, smell the air.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm wind smells like cut hay.
dialogue.zh: 暖風聞起來像割下的乾草。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Country roads always calm me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My arms ache in a good way.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ɑrmz eɪk ɪn ə ɡʊd weɪ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's honest work paying off.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nobody checked their phones once.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Funny how that happens outside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's cook something with these tonight.
dialogue.zh: 今晚用這些做點東西吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pancakes with berries and cream.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Save some for your mother too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She gets the first full bowl.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That jam will last through winter.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe until the next berry season.
dialogue.zh: 也許能撐到下個莓果季。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seasons pass faster every single year.
dialogue.zh: 每一年季節都過得更快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's why we should keep coming.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time bring the whole family.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even grandpa, he'd love it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He'd tell us every trick again.
dialogue.zh: 他又會把所有訣竅講一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'd listen properly this time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turning onto our street now.
dialogue.zh: 現在轉進我們那條街了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Home feels different after today.
dialogue.zh: 經過今天，家感覺不一樣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Unload the car before we rest.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Berries first, then the baskets.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rinse them under cool running water.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pat them dry on a towel.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One bowl for tonight's dessert.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the rest into the fridge.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That purple stain won't come out.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wear it again next berry trip.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Photos are already in the group chat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfoʊtoʊz ər ɔlˈrɛdi ɪn ðə ɡrup tʃæt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone wants the jam recipe now.
dialogue.zh: 現在大家都想要果醬食譜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep will come easily tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fresh air does that to people.
dialogue.zh: 新鮮空氣對人就是這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same farm, same row next time?
dialogue.zh: 下次同樣的農場、同樣那排？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if nobody picks it first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We'll hide a few under the leaves.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl haɪd ə fju ˈʌndər ðə livz/
dialogue.zh: 我們會藏幾顆在葉子下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clever, that's what birds do.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time to close the curtains now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lights off, one last berry each.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sweet dreams about the farm.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See you at the farm again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Goodnight, and thanks for today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Best morning we've had in months.
dialogue.zh: 這是我們幾個月來最棒的早晨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us do this again soon.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can still smell the berries.
dialogue.zh: 我還聞得到莓果的香味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow we'll taste the jam.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And remember this warm day.
